yogas.name: Vesai Yoga
yogas.note: There is a planet other than Moon in the 2nd house from Sun

yogas.name: Vosi Yoga
yogas.note: There is a planet other than Moon in the 12th house from Sun

yogas.name: Ubhayachara Yoga
yogas.note: There are planets other than Moon in the 2nd and 12th houses from Sun

yogas.name: Sunaphaa Yoga
yogas.note: There are planets other than Sun in the 2nd house from Moon

yogas.name: Anaphaa Yoga
yogas.note: There are planets other than Sun in the 12th house from Moon

yogas.name: Duradhara Yoga
yogas.note: There are planets other than Sun in the 2nd and 12th houses from Moon.

yogas.name: Paasa Yoga
yogas.note: The seven planets occupy exactly 5 distinct signs among them.

yogas.name: Subha Yoga
yogas.note: Lagna has benefics or has “subha kartari – benefics in 12th and 2nd house from Lagna.

yogas.name: Asubha Yoga
yogas.note: Lagna has malefics or has “paapa kartari or maleefics in 12th and 2nd house from Lagna.

yogas.name: Bheri Yoga

yogas.name: Matsya Yoga
yogas.note: If (1) benefics are in lagna and 9th, (2) some planets are in 5th, and, (3) malefics are in chaturasras (4th and 8th houses), then this yoga is present.

yogas.name: Bhaarathi Yoga
yogas.note: If the lord of the sign occupied in navamsa by 2nd, 5th or 11th lord exalted and joins the 9th lord, then this yoga is present.

yogas.name: Harsha Yoga
yogas.note: If the 6th lord occupies the 6th house, then this yoga is present.
